image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs resting on a bed of crushed ice. The crabs exhibit the characteristic bright orange-red coloration of cooked crustaceans. Multiple individuals are visible, overlapping in a dense arrangement. The central crab is partially obscured but shows the dorsal carapace and legs. Other crabs in the foreground and background show ventral surfaces (white/cream) and leg structures. The scene suggests a seafood market or restaurant display.

AI models often fail to maintain distinct boundaries here, leading to 'melting' or fused limbs. Use topology_boundary_auditor to confirm these are separate entities. Also, verify if the coloration is consistent with cooked Dungeness crab (uniform orange-red) rather than raw (mottled brown/purple), as the checkpoint description references raw traits which may cause false negatives if not contextualized. Finally, ensure the crabs cast appropriate contact shadows on the ice to confirm physical grounding.
